import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Digital Camera Specifications Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sensor_types = df['sensor_type'].unique()
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', len(sensor_types))
for i, sensor in enumerate(sensor_types):
    mask = df['sensor_type'] == sensor
    ax1.scatter(df.loc[mask, 'megapixels'], df.loc[mask, 'price_usd'], 
                alpha=0.6, label=sensor, color=colors[i], s=40)
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sensor Type', loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 2: Average Price by Brand (Top 10 brands by count)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
top_brands = df['brand'].value_counts().nlargest(10).index
brand_prices = df[df['brand'].isin(top_brands)].groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars = ax2.barh(brand_prices.index, brand_prices.values, color=sns.color_palette('viridis', len(brand_prices)))
ax2.set_xlabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Brand', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Average Camera Price by Brand (Top 10)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='x')
for i, v in enumerate(brand_prices.values):
    ax2.text(v + 50, i, f'${v:.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# Plot 3: Camera Count by Body Type and 4K Video Capability
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
body_4k = pd.crosstab(df['body_type'], df['has_video_4k'])
body_4k.columns = ['No 4K', 'Has 4K']
body_4k.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=['#ff7f0e', '#2ca02c'], edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax3.set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Cameras', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Camera Distribution by Body Type & 4K Capability', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='4K Video', fontsize=10)
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Plot 4: Megapixels Evolution Over Model Years
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
yearly_stats = df.groupby('model_year')['megapixels'].agg(['mean', 'std']).reset_index()
ax4.plot(yearly_stats['model_year'], yearly_stats['mean'], 'b-o', linewidth=2, markersize=6, label='Mean Megapixels')
ax4.fill_between(yearly_stats['model_year'], 
                  yearly_stats['mean'] - yearly_stats['std'], 
                  yearly_stats['mean'] + yearly_stats['std'], 
                  alpha=0.2, color='blue', label='±1 Std Dev')
ax4.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Evolution of Camera Resolution Over Time', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=10)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
